page-structure.evidence: Title 'NFL on ESPN - Scores, Stats and Highlights' is descriptive (2.4.2 passes). Heading tree has no h1 at page level (axe best-practice; not a WCAG SC). Multiple empty <h3> elements (7 confirmed by verify-finding.js) — empty headings fail 1.3.1/2.4.6. Duplicate h2 text 'Favorites' appears 3×, 'Fantasy' appears 2× — duplicate non-unique headings (landmark-unique pattern). No <main> or role=main landmark anywhere on page (confirmed: hasMain=false; axe landmark-one-main reproduced) — 1.3.1 landmark failure. Three <nav> elements, none with aria-label or aria-labelledby — indistinguishable to AT (axe landmark-unique). listStyleNone=111 lists stripped of semantics for Safari/VoiceOver (1.3.1, WebKit-specific). h2 'ESPN' appears before h1 'NFL' in DOM — document order issue.

No modal overlays open in the static snapshot to check background aria-hidden.
